item.title: Washington Eyes Bigger Cyber Role for Private Sector
item.description: The White House’s new cyber strategy pushes companies to play a larger role in identifying and disrupting hackers, raising legal, security and geopolitical questions. Also, companies are claiming climate credits for a project that hasn’t been completed. Listen on: Listen on: Transcript

item.title: Security Chiefs Grapple with Looming AI Threats
item.description: The annual RSAC Conference in San Francisco is dominated by artificial intelligence. This year, however, there seems to be a more pragmatic appreciation of what AI is actually doing to cyber defense. Also, fertilizer is emerging as a serious problem.

item.title: Webinar Summary: WSJ Pro Women to Watch – 10-Year Anniversary Conversation
item.description: This special The Wall Street Journal webinar marked the 10th anniversary of the Women to Watch list, featuring insights from Elizabeth Weymouth (Founder, Managing Partner, Grafine Partners) and Alisa Carmichael (Partner, VMG Partners), moderated by Laura Kreutzer, Bureau Chief for WSJ Pro Private Equity.The discussion combined personal career reflections with a forward-looking view of private equity.
